'''''Oenothera humifusa''''', the '''seabeach evening primrose''' or '''spreading evening primrose''', is a species of flowering plant in the family [[Onagraceae]].<ref name="OEHU" >{{cite web |url=https://www.wildflower.org/plants/result.php?id_plant=OEHU |title=''Oenothera humifusa'' Nutt. |last1=Marcus |first1=Joseph A. |date=20 April 2023 |website=Plant Database |publisher=Lady Bird Johnson Wildflower Center |access-date=29 November 2023 }}</ref> It is native to the beaches of Bermuda and the eastern United States from Louisiana to New Jersey, and it has been introduced to Cuba.<ref name="POWO_613788-1" >{{cite POWO |id=613788-1 |title=''Oenothera humifusa'' Nutt. |access-date=29 November 2023 }}</ref> It is a decumbent perennial.<ref name="OEHU" />
